title: Haptiq Expands U.S. Presence with New Headquarters at 10 Grand Central in New York City

Sep 10, 2025 8:00 AM Eastern Daylight Time

# **Haptiq Expands U.S. Presence with New Headquarters at 10 Grand Central in New York City**

Share

* * *

_AI-Native enterprise operations leader strengthens domestic footprint in the heart of U.S. private equity_

NEW YORK--( [BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/))--Haptiq, the AI-native enterprise operations platform purpose-built for private equity and portfolio operations teams, today announced the official opening of its New York City headquarters, located at 10 Grand Central. The move marks a significant milestone in the company’s domestic growth strategy, cementing its presence in one of the world’s most influential financial hubs and the epicenter of private equity in the United States.

The new headquarters will serve as a central hub for client engaging clients, product innovation, and service delivery, accelerating the adoption of **Haptiq Core**, the company’s AI-powered platform designed to unify operations, streamline decision-making, and drive measurable value creation across enterprises.

“Haptiq Core eliminates data silos, automates complex workflows, and delivers predictive insights that help firms generate alpha at scale,” said Alon Tvina, CEO at Haptiq. “Expanding our presence in New York brings us closer to the firms we serve and reinforces our commitment to transforming operational performance through AI.”

Built for the speed and complexity of today’s private equity environment, Haptiq Core centralizes operational, financial, and strategic data into a real-time single source of truth. This empowers portfolio teams to optimize processes, enhance cross-functional visibility, and scale with confidence. With enterprise-grade scalability, robust cybersecurity, and flexible integrations, the platform is designed for the complex needs of PE-backed organizations and enterprise operators alike.

**About Haptiq**

Haptiq is an AI-powered enterprise operations platform built to help private equity firms and their portfolio companies accelerate alpha and drive higher valuations. By centralizing data, automating operational workflows, and delivering predictive insights, Haptiq enables faster decision-making, enhanced scalability, and measurable value creation across complex, asset-intensive environments.
